claim: Executive Order 14324, signed July 30, 2025, suspended de minimis for non-postal shipments entered on or after 12:01 a.m. EDT on August 29, 2025.

claim: For postal items, EO 14324 let carriers choose an ad valorem duty or, for six months, a specific duty of $80, $160 or $200 per item based on the origin country's effective IEEPA tariff rate.

evidence: less than 16 percent: $80 per item ... $160 per item ... above 25 percent: $200 per item.
